def transform(g):
    g=[row[:] for row in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find maximal rectangles of 2s: for each top-left 2 at (i,j), box borders all 2? find rectangles
    boxes=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if g[i][j]!=2: continue

            if j>0 and g[i][j-1]==2: continue
            # candidate top-left; find width/height along edges
            wi=0
            while j+wi<w and g[i][j+wi]==2: wi+=1
            hi=0
